First Timers Cancellation Policy The Well Labs+ Blog FAQ’s Financing Contact Virtual Consultation Book Now About Us Get to know the expert team here at About Face — A Well Labs+ Medspa! We’ve been creating incredible results for patients in the Portsmouth and Stratham areas, and we can’t wait to learn more about what we can do for you. BOOK A CONSULTATION Innovative Technologies Pro-Nox™ We offer PRO-NOX™, a nitrous oxide gas system that is amazing at reducing pain and anxiety before treatment. It’s 5-minute half-life means effects wear off quickly post-treatment, so you can drive home afterwards. Visia® We use the Visia® Skin Analysis System to look beneath your skin’s surface during your consultation, providing detailed imaging and analysis that will help us make the best treatment recommendations. AccuVein® We are able to drastically reduce the likelihood of burising after injectable services by using AccuVein®. This innovative technology allows us to see the location of the veins and blood vessels beneath the surface of the skin.
